note: Recast from the description of the new species in Cuezzo & Cancello (2009), original in English; all measurements follow the ranges of the original and the holotype values (in parentheses), in mm; the label abbreviations are unchanged: LH head length, LHp head length to the base of the nasus, WH head width, WHfr head width at the anterior margin of the antennal socket, WHr head width at the posterior margin of the antennal socket, HH head height, WP pronotum width, LT hind tibia length, LMI left mandible index.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The species is described from material from Venezuela and Trinidad and Tobago, with two soldier morphs and polymorphic workers; the description also provides strong evidence that Parvitermes bacchanalis should not be placed in Obtusitermes. The specific name formosulus is Latin for beautiful.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Two morphs. In lateral view the nasus is nearly conical in the major soldier and nearly cylindrical in the minor soldier. Rudimentary mandibles without a point. Postclypeus inflated. Labrum short, anterior margin rounded. A ridge runs from the postclypeus along the upper margin of the antennal socket. Antenna 11 segments, segment 3 subclavate, longer than 2 and 4, segments 5 to 8 similar in size and shape, segments 9 to 11 similar. Anterior margin of the pronotum rounded, not concave. Tibial spurs 2:2:2. Nasus dark brown, paler apically; anterior half of the head capsule yellowish brown, grading to pale yellow behind; antenna yellow; pronotum, mesonotum and metanotum yellow. Major soldier: head capsule in dorsal view with a distinct but not excessive constriction behind the antennal bases, greatest width in the middle of the posterior part of the head behind the constriction; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head converging towards the nasus, the base of the nasus without depression or swelling; nasus and head capsule with scattered microtrichia, 4 erect setae at the base of the nasus, another 2 erect setae on the vertex and several hairs of varied length and direction; 4 setae and short hairs at the apex of the nasus; anterior margin of the postmentum with two rows of setae, the front row with at least 4 and the rear row with 2; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum with microtrichia, and likewise the posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum; posterior margin of the abdominal tergites with 4 erect setae and the surface with decumbent hairs, posterior margin of the sternites with a row of long setae and the surface with scattered setae. Measurements of 6 soldiers: head length (LH) 1.14—1.23; postmentum length (LHp) 0.70—0.78; head width (WH) 0.61—0.70; head height (HH) 0.43—0.50; pronotum width (WP) 0.35—0.38; hind tibia length (LT) 0.59—0.63. Minor soldier: head capsule in dorsal view from the base of the nasus to the posterior margin of the head, the constriction distinct and situated slightly anterior to the middle of the head; the part in front of the constriction nearly as wide as the part behind; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head with a slight swelling at the base of the nasus and slightly concave behind it; chaetotaxy as in the major soldier, with fewer decumbent hairs on the vertex. Measurements of 6 soldiers (holotype in parentheses): head length 1.01—1.05 (1.05); postmentum length 0.61—0.65 (0.65); head width (frontal region) 0.45—0.48 (0.46); head width (posterior region) 0.45—0.50 (0.49); head height 0.33—0.36 (0.35); pronotum width 0.30—0.35 (0.34); hind tibia length 0.59—0.64 (0.60).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Two categories are distinguished by mandible morphology, head capsule colour and the dorsal profile of the head: the smaller dark worker has wide-gap mandibles, a darker head capsule and, in lateral view, a concave anterior and a raised posterior dorsal margin of the head; the larger pale worker has narrow-gap mandibles, a paler head capsule and a convex dorsal margin of the head in lateral view. The former is far rarer than the latter, and the latter also varies in head capsule size. All workers: head capsule in dorsal view with the lateral margins nearly parallel or converging forwards, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle region slightly concave; postclypeus moderately inflated; antenna 12 segments. Anterior lobe of the pronotum more developed than the posterior lobe, anterior margin rounded, not concave. Tibial spurs 2:2:2. The digestive tube is visible through the abdominal wall. Pronotum with a few short hairs on the anterior and posterior margins only; abdominal tergites with short hairs on the surface and setae on the posterior margin. Smaller dark worker (MZUSP 11254, one specimen): head width 0.69; hind tibia length 0.59; left mandible index 0.44. Larger pale worker, large (MZUSP 10250, five specimens): head width 0.80—0.85; hind tibia length 0.50—0.53; left mandible index 0.44—0.56. Larger pale worker, small (MZUSP 10250, five specimens; 11254, three specimens): head width 0.70—0.74; hind tibia length 0.50—0.55; left mandible index 0.40—0.56.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Digestive tube of the generic pattern: crop and gizzard indistinct in dorsal view; gizzard with a complete, weakly sclerotised six-radiate armature, without spines or scales, the pulvillar band more developed than the columnar band. Midgut short, extending to the right dorsally, not reaching the midline in ventral view. Mixed segment well developed, with a distinctive midgut tongue near the proximal end on the inner side, the distal end turning ventrally so that the mixed segment is an asymmetric structure. Malpighian tubules paired, the two groups close together, attached to a small projection of midgut tissue on the inner side of the midgut loop at the midgut-hindgut junction, and swollen along the whole length of the mixed segment. Left mandible: larger pale worker (narrow gap), apical tooth not projecting beyond M1+2, posterior margin of the apical tooth concave and forming an acute angle with the anterior margin of M1+2, posterior margin of M1+2 nearly straight, third marginal tooth distinct, separated from the molar prominence by a V-shaped notch, molar teeth almost invisible at the notch, their apices hidden beneath the molar prominence, the molar prominence ridged and semi-transparent; right mandible, apical tooth about as large as the first marginal tooth, second marginal tooth smaller with a blunt apex, molar plate with 5 distinct ridges and 1 weak ridge, basal notch clear. Smaller dark worker (wide gap): posterior margin of the left apical tooth straight, the notch between the third tooth and the molar prominence wider; right apical tooth with a distinctive posterior margin, second marginal tooth indistinct, molar plate narrower with 4 distinct ridges and 1 weak ridge, basal notch less distinct.
